market_summary: The market is experiencing a mid-to-late New York session contraction phase. Metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD), major FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD), and BTCUSD remain in macro downtrends trading below their daily session VWAPs and descending EMA50 baselines, but are currently consolidating above session lows on low volume (RVOL < 1.0) and divergent or fading CVD deltas. Meanwhile, US100 trades in a positive dampening GEX regime above its Gamma Flip and session VWAP, currently undergoing a corrective mean-reverting pullback from Call Wall #1 toward Put Wall #1 and the EMA20 baseline. With low participation across all assets and setups stalled mid-channel or pressing into nearby structural supports/walls, disciplined risk management dictates HOLD across the entire watch list.
